description: The 2016 family memoir characterizes Florence as Olive's life partner. 1941 and 1947 Newton records place Florence at the same Elm Street address listed for Olive in 1947. These are evidence of an association and shared address, not a marriage certificate or a reason to make a spouses tree edge.
